name: The District at Tustin Legacy
summary: The District at Tustin Legacy is a premier open-air lifestyle center featuring an extensive collection of retail stores, diverse dining options, and regular community events. This modern shopping destination offers a walkable, outdoor experience that has become a central hub for the Tustin Legacy community.
demographics: The District at Tustin Legacy attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic with median household incomes significantly above the Orange County average. The primary trade area draws from Tustin, Irvine, and surrounding communities, with visitors typically aged 25-54 who value outdoor shopping experiences and upscale dining options. The center appeals to young professionals and established families seeking a mix of quality retail, entertainment, and social gathering spaces in a modern open-air environment.
description: The District at Tustin Legacy stands as one of Orange County's premier outdoor lifestyle destinations, transforming the former Tustin Marine Corps Air Station into a vibrant mixed-use development. This expansive open-air shopping center seamlessly blends retail, dining, and entertainment in a pedestrian-friendly environment that has become a cornerstone of the Tustin Legacy master-planned community. With its wide tree-lined walkways and contemporary architecture, The District offers visitors an elevated shopping experience that goes beyond traditional mall formats. The center has established itself as a regional draw with its impressive array of dining options, ranging from casual eateries to upscale restaurants, making it a popular destination for both daytime shopping and evening entertainment. Regular community events and seasonal programming further enhance the center's appeal, creating a dynamic gathering place that serves both local residents and visitors from throughout Orange County.
